reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Employment
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the job market. While AI automation will eliminate some traditional roles, it simultaneously creates new opportunities in tech, maintenance, and human oversight sectors. Experts predict that workers who adapt and develop digital skills will thrive. Companies investing in employee retraining programs report higher productivity and employee satisfaction. The transition requires collaborative efforts between government, educational institutions, and businesses to ensure equitable job creation and sustainable economic growth.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one positive outcome of AI in the job market?
options: New opportunities are created in tech and maintenance sectors
Digital skills are no longer necessary
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'it simultaneously creates new opportunities in tech, maintenance, and human oversight sectors'라고 명시되어 있습니다. AI가 일부 직업을 없애지만 새로운 기회를 만든다는 균형잡힌 관점을 보여줍니다.

questions.q: What do companies with retraining programs experience?
questions.explanation: 'Companies investing in employee retraining programs report higher productivity and employee satisfaction'라는 문장에서 직접 답을 찾을 수 있습니다.

questions.q: Which groups are mentioned as necessary for successful AI transition?
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 'collaborative efforts between government, educational institutions, and businesses'라고 명확히 언급되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made our lives better'? Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현으로 시작. 예: 'I strongly agree that technology has significantly improved our quality of life' 또는 'While technology offers benefits, I believe its drawbacks outweigh advantages'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유: 의료 분야의 발전 - 진단 기술 개선, 원격진료 가능성 등 구체적 예시 제시
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유: 커뮤니케이션 혁신 - 지리적 거리 극복, 실시간 연결, 관계 유지 용이성
structure.conclusion: 입장을 재확인하고 종합적 의견 제시. 미래에 대한 긍정적 전망이나 고려사항 언급

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology has fundamentally transformed...
To illustrate this point, consider the advancements in...
In conclusion, the benefits of technology clearly outweigh the drawbacks because...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study alone in a quiet environment. Others prefer to study in groups with classmates. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer studying in groups because...
One reason is that group study allows me to...
Another advantage is that I can explain concepts to others, which helps reinforce my own understanding.
For example, when I study with classmates, we can discuss difficult problems together.
In contrast, some people might argue that studying alone is better, but I believe...
sample_points: 그룹 스터디의 장점: 다양한 관점 공유, 어려운 부분을 함께 해결, 토론을 통한 깊이있는 이해 증진, 동기부여 향상
구체적 예시: 어려운 수학 문제를 친구들과 함께 풀면서 다양한 해결 방법을 배움, 설명하는 과정에서 개념이 명확해짐

listening.title: University Library Orientation
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I'm new here and I'm not sure how to find research materials for my history project. Librarian: Welcome! I'd be happy to help. First, you can use our online database system to search for books and academic journals. We have access to thousands of scholarly articles related to history. Student: That sounds helpful. How do I access it? Librarian: You can use your student ID and password to log in from any computer on campus or from home. We also offer free workshops every Wednesday at 2 PM where I teach students advanced search techniques. Additionally, I recommend visiting our history section in the third floor where you'll find primary sources and historical documents. Student: Great! And what if I have questions while researching? Librarian: You can come back and ask me directly, or use our online chat service available from 9 AM to 8 PM daily. We also have research consultants who can schedule one-on-one appointments with you.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: To explain library rules and regulations
To provide orientation about library research resources and services
To register the student for a library membership
To schedule the student's first library visit
questions.explanation: 도서관 사서가 신입 학생에게 도서관의 여러 리소스(온라인 데이터베이스, 워크숍, 3층 역사 섹션, 온라인 채팅 서비스)에 대해 설명하고 있습니다. 이는 도서관 오리엔테이션의 전형적인 내용입니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, where can the student find primary sources?
options: In the history section on the third floor
questions.explanation: 사서가 'I recommend visiting our history section in the third floor where you'll find primary sources and historical documents'라고 명확히 언급했습니다.

questions.q: What services does the library offer for students who need help during research?
options: Online chat service and one-on-one appointments with consultants
questions.explanation: 사서가 'You can come back and ask me directly, or use our online chat service available from 9 AM to 8 PM daily. We also have research consultants who can schedule one-on-one appointments with you'라고 설명했습니다.
